info.name: DummyJSON
info.description:
Manual QA API Testing Portfolio - DummyJSON

This collection demonstrates authentication testing techniques using the DummyJSON REST API.

Features covered:  
• Login authentication  
• JWT Bearer Token handling  
• Request chaining  
• Data-driven testing (CSV/JSON)  
• Positive testing  
• Negative testing  
• Response validation  
• JSON Schema validation  
• Collection and environment variables

The purpose of this collection is to demonstrate API testing practices commonly used in professional QA environments.

Author: Karen Romero

item.name: ✅ Positive

request.description:
Authenticates a user using valid credentials.

This request validates the login endpoint and verifies that a valid JWT access token and refresh token are returned.

The request also stores authentication data in collection variables for use in subsequent requests.

Expected Result:  
• HTTP 200 OK  
• Valid JWT access token  
• Refresh token  
• User information returned

exec: pm.test("Returned user ID matches authenticated user", () => {
pm.test("User ID is a positive integer", () => {

request.description:
Retrieves the profile information of the currently authenticated user.

This request validates that the JWT access token generated during the login process is accepted and returns the expected user information.

The request also verifies that the authenticated user matches the data returned by the Login request.

Expected Result:  
• HTTP 200 OK  
• Valid authenticated user information  
• Returned user matches the authenticated session

item.description: Contains positive test scenarios that verify the expected behavior of the authentication endpoints using valid input data.

item.name: ❌ Negative

request.description:
Attempts to authenticate using a username that does not exist.

Expected Result:  
• Authentication fails.  
• Appropriate HTTP status code is returned.  
• Error message indicates invalid credentials.

Attempts to authenticate using a valid username and an invalid password.

Expected Result:  
• Authentication fails.  
• HTTP 400 Bad Request is returned.  
• Error message indicates invalid credentials.

Attempts to authenticate without providing the required username.

Expected Result:  
• Authentication fails.  
• HTTP 400 Bad Request is returned.  
• Error message indicates that both username and password are required.

Attempts to authenticate without providing the required password.

Expected Result:  
• Authentication fails.  
• HTTP 400 Bad Request is returned.  
• Error message indicates that both username and password are required.

Attempts to authenticate without providing any credentials.

Expected Result:  
• Authentication fails.  
• HTTP 400 Bad Request is returned.  
• Error message indicates that both username and password are required.

Attempts to access a protected endpoint without providing a valid Bearer token.

Expected Result:  
• HTTP 401 Unauthorized is returned.  
• Access to the protected resource is denied.  
• Error message indicates that authentication is required or the token is invalid.

Attempts to access a protected endpoint using an invalid Bearer token.

Expected Result:  
• HTTP 401 Unauthorized is returned.  
• Access to the protected resource is denied.  
• Error message indicates that the provided token is invalid or expired.

Attempts to invoke the login endpoint using an unsupported HTTP method (DELETE).

Expected Result:  
• The request is rejected.  
• HTTP 404 Not Found is returned by the API.  
• The response indicates that the DELETE route is not implemented.

item.description: Contains negative test scenarios that validate error handling, input validation, and authentication failures using invalid or missing data.

item.name: 🔁 Data Driven

request.description:
Authenticates users using credentials supplied by an external CSV file.

Each row is executed as an independent test case, allowing positive and negative login scenarios to be validated in a single collection run.

Expected Result:  
• Valid credentials return HTTP 200.  
• Invalid credentials return HTTP 400.

item.description:
Executes the same API request using multiple datasets from external CSV and JSON files.

Demonstrates efficient test execution, reusable test scripts, and validation of multiple scenarios without duplicating requests.
